subject: Vendor master: initial entity validation & PO-routing checklist
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <accounts@helmtech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor master: initial entity validation & PO-routing checklist

Hi Alex —

Thanks for working with us on the HelmTech onboarding. To get the vendor master created cleanly on our side we need the following items so AP/Procurement can route POs and payments without delays: 

1) Legal entity name exactly as appears on tax forms (include DBA if applicable)
2) Entity type (Corp / LLC / Partnership / Sole Proprietor) and EIN / Tax ID
3) Registered address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
4) Remittance contact name + email + preferred invoice format (PDF / EDI / portal)
5) Bank wiring details (bank name, account name, last 4 digits) — we accept a redacted PDF if you prefer (no full account numbers in email)
6) W9 (or W-8 if non-US) or equivalent tax form
7) Photo/scan of a proof-of-address or certificate of formation if the legal name differs from public records
8) Preferred PO routing (ops@helmtech.com, invoices@helmtech.com or EDI partner setup) and any special PO acceptance notes

I’ve attached our vendor profile form (redwood_vendor_profile_form.pdf) — if you can complete and return that + the W9 that will speed things up. If any of the items above will take time, please indicate what you can provide immediately and what needs follow-up.

Target: if we can get the basics by EOD Monday (6/22) we can turn the record on and issue a test PO next week.

Thanks,

--
Jasmine Liu
Vendor Operations | Procurement
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_vendor_profile_form.pdf

5) Preferred PO routing: ops@helmtech.com; billing@helmtech.com also receives invoices. No EDI at this time.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor master: initial entity validation & PO-routing checklist

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifying items before we finalize the master record: 

- The W9 shows legal name "HelmTech Solutions, Inc." but our internal vendor registry has an existing entry for "HelmTech, LLC" from an older contract. Can you confirm if "HelmTech, LLC" is a separate legal entity (different EIN) or a former DBA? If separate, we’ll need the formation docs for both.

- For remittance: Claudia's email is fine. Can you confirm whether invoices should route to ops@helmtech.com with a copy to billing@helmtech.com, or whether ops is strictly for PO acknowledgements? We want to avoid missed invoices.

- For bank wiring we only need bank name and last 4 digits in the email. For final onboarding our Payments team will ask for a bank verification (small ACH micro-deposit or a bank letter). Are you able to complete that verification?

Quote from Alex's email for context:
> 1) Legal name: HelmTech Solutions, Inc.
> 2) Entity type: C-Corp; EIN: 12-3456789
> 3) Registered address: 401 Harbor Way, Suite 300, San Diego, CA 92101, USA

If you can confirm the two points above we can proceed to record creation. If you prefer a short call to run through the two items, happy to set up 20 minutes Monday.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Sr. Vendor Analyst | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <accounts@helmtech.com>, Claudia Reyes <claudia.reyes@helmtech.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor master: initial entity validation & PO-routing checklist

Alex / Claudia —

Thanks for confirming. Per Kimberly's question we checked legacy records and HelmTech, LLC is a separate historical vendor (different EIN) and will remain distinct. We will create a new master record for HelmTech Solutions, Inc. using the details you provided. Next steps: 

- Record created: RED-VM-2026-1179 (HelmTech Solutions, Inc.)
- PO routing: ops@helmtech.com will receive POs; please cc billing@helmtech.com when submitting invoices to ensure AP pickup.
- Test PO: we will issue a $0.01 test PO to ops@helmtech.com this afternoon — please confirm receipt and PO number in reply so we can move to live issuance.
- Payments verification: our Payments team will send a secure bank verification link to Claudia (claudia.reyes@helmtech.com) to complete the micro-deposit.

I’ve attached the completed vendor profile we uploaded to the registry for your review. If everything looks correct we’ll schedule the first live PO on Thursday. 

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Regards,
